subject: Structuring compliance add-ons: tranche discount & evidence milestones
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sunit Mehra <sunit.mehra@medvera.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-07T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance add-ons — quick question on structuring discounts

Hi Sunit,

Thanks again for the time on Wednesday — good overview of MedVera’s rollout plan. A quick operational question as we put together a formal quote: how would your procurement team prefer discounts for the compliance add-ons to be structured? Two approaches we commonly see and I want to confirm which maps to your internal approval flows: 

1) Tranche-based credits tied to evidence milestones (e.g., initial SOC2 evidence delivery → partial credit; residency activation → additional credit; HSM onboarding → final credit).
2) Flat volume discount on the combined add-on list price keyed to committed throughput/annual spend.

If tranche-based, what milestones would you want to see on your side (we can map deliverables + evidence types)? If volume-based, what commit band would trigger the 10–20% discount you mentioned?

I’ve attached a working pricing workbook with sample amortization for HSM seats and audit-log ingestion bands to make it concrete.

Would you and procurement be able to confirm which structure they’d prefer by next Tuesday so we can issue a term sheet?

Best,
Rafael
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Pack_Pricing_v1.xlsx
From: Sunit Mehra <sunit.mehra@medvera.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medvera.com
Date: 2027-04-07T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — quick question on structuring discounts

Thanks Rafael — helpful framing. Procurement prefers tranche-based credits tied to evidence milestones. That maps better to how we budget and get signoff from security and finance. Proposed milestones on our side:

- Proof-of-concept completion (functional + security smoke tests) → 25% credit
- SOC2 evidence delivered (audit-ready artifacts uploaded) → 35% credit
- Production residency activation (EU or US region as applicable) → 25% credit
- HSM/KMS operational and keys rotated at 30d → 15% credit

We’d like credits to apply against the first 12 months of recurring compliance addon fees. For HSM, we typically ask for a 12–18 month amortization window for one-time onboarding fees.

I’ll loop in procurement formally and share a baseline term sheet we use for similar vendors.

—Sunit
Director of Platform Ops, MedVera
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sunit Mehra <sunit.mehra@medvera.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-08T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — quick question on structuring discounts

Appreciate the detail, Sunit — that tranche split is reasonable. A few clarifying comments from our side before we craft the term sheet: 

- Credit timing: we generally apply credits as invoice line-item credits over the next 12 billing cycles after milestone acceptance. Can you confirm that aligns with MedVera’s accounting (i.e., credits used against recurring invoices)?
- Evidence acceptance: to avoid ambiguity we suggest an evidence acceptance checklist (SOC2 artifacts, system logs, test reports). Happy to use your checklist; otherwise we can propose one.
- HSM amortization: we can offer a 12-month amortization for onboarding fees at 0% interest. If you need 18 months we can consider it but would like to reserve the right to reduce the total credit amount slightly (e.g., 10% instead of 15%) to reflect extended concession.

I’m attaching a short sample term sheet and a SOC2 checklist we typically accept. Two asks: if procurement can give us the official PO/term-sheet template and if security can confirm the evidence items for milestone 2 (SOC2).

If that all looks good I’ll produce a formal term sheet by EOD Friday and route for legal review.

Best,
Rafael

Attachments: MedVera_Term_Sheet_Request.pdf; SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx
From: procurement@medvera.com
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-09T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — quick question on structuring discounts

Hi Rafael / team,

Thanks — I’m procurement at MedVera (procurement@medvera.com). Attached is our vendor term-sheet template and the internal approval matrix. A couple notes from finance: credits need to be itemized on invoices and visible in our accounting system (we cannot accept opaque retroactive adjustments). Also, we require an evidence acceptance window of 7 business days after submission for the SOC2 artifacts.

We’ve also included a separate note asking if Redwood can provide a single-pane report that lists evidence accepted, credits applied, and remaining credit balance per milestone — that makes approvals much faster for us.

Attaching: MedVera_Term_Sheet_Request.pdf (our template) and Procurement_Approval_Matrix.xlsx

Regards,
MedVera Procurement
procurement@medvera.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: procurement@medvera.com, Sunit Mehra <sunit.mehra@medvera.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-09T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — quick question on structuring discounts

Hi — thanks for the templates and the clarification on invoicing / acceptance windows. Quick confirmation and next steps from Redwood: 

- We will produce a term sheet that: 1) itemizes the credits per milestone and applies credits as line-item credits across the following 12 invoices, 2) includes a 7-business-day acceptance window for SOC2 artifact review, and 3) provides a monthly evidence-credit ledger accessible via the Redwood Console (we’ll share a read-only link you can download).
- HSM amortization: we’ll default to 12 months at 0% for onboarding; if you request 18 months we can split the difference by moving to a 12-month schedule but increasing the onboarding credit by 10% (net-neutral to Redwood economics).
- Delivery: term sheet and pricing workbook v2 will be in your Drive link by EOD tomorrow.

Looping Laura and Ben for any final commercial guardrails. Laura — any contractual constraints we should surface to procurement before I send to legal? Ben — heads up on credit ledger work (we’ll need product to expose a read-only CSV).

Thanks,
Rafael

---
Internal note (not part of the external thread): Laura / Ben, short call tomorrow morning to finalize the exact credit percentages and whether we can accept the 18-month amortization at the adjusted credit level. Prefer to keep total concession <= 18% of add-on ARR.
